title: Effect of Vitamin D Treatment in Primary Hyperparathyroidism
brief_summary: The primary aim of the study is to assess whether 6-months of vitamin D supplements can decrease PTH compared with placebo treatment in primary hyperparathyroidism.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* P-Ca-ion \> 1,30 mmol/l
* P-PTH \> 5 pmol/l
* P-OH25-vitamin D \< 80 nmol/l

Exclusion Criteria:

* P-creatinin \> 120 mumol/l
* usage of Etalpha, Mimpara
* Cancer
* Sarcoidosis
* malabsorption
* pancreatitis
* alcohol abuse
* pregnancy
